mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, c.teacher_name AS teacher FROM course c WHERE c.teacher_name = #{teacherName} ORDER BY c.id

SELECT sc.id AS id, sc.course_id AS courseId, sc.student_name AS studentName, c.name AS courseName, sc.semester AS semester, sc.status AS status, sc.score AS score, sc.select_time AS selectTime, sc.remark AS remark FROM student_course sc JOIN course c ON c.id = sc.course_id WHERE sc.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY sc.id
mapper.update: UPDATE student_course SET score = #{score} WHERE id = #{id}
